config.eligibility: ALL methods share EXACT same window set within each horizon; nonterminal targets only
config.near_terminal_policy: per_horizon includes all eligible late frames; common10 restricts to ten-step-capable contexts
config.static_task: q gets exact target distance; consistency, not forecasting
config.temporal_task: past3 synchronized features + recorded open-loop actions; no future image/speed inputs
config.actor_task: same target TRUE speed supplied to all actors; isolates latent effects, not full speed prediction
config.collector: old PPO09, not the candidate models or native_R2

minimal_actor_identity.note: identity/legacy-check evidence only; not an image-path safety certificate
minimal_actor_identity.inference: deterministic actor mean clipped to [-3,3]; no QP; no SBC action filtering
